events.what: Adams, Ionov, Mason-Brown and Vogan claim a proof that all Arthur packets of real reductive groups consist of unitary representations (plus Jiang's conjecture for real groups)
Yang extends the support-equality conjecture posed alongside the June paper

judgement.doubts: Agree with the earlier hand correction (claimed -> partial): the bullet names Arthur's conjectures as a whole, and the unitarity statement for real groups is one component (local, archimedean only); the record says the endoscopic classification, multiplicity formula and non-archimedean/global cases remain conjectural (F1/F2). The Pith review is automated and neither verification nor refutation (F11). The Yang preprint builds on a conjecture from the paper and is not a check of the unitarity proof.
